answer: A sybil swarm must fund many identities, so forging peer attestations costs the attacker the full bonded value per fake identity plus slashing. One concrete mechanism is a stake-and-slash registry: each agent locks a bond to register, and every attestation it signs is weighted by that bond. An honest agent signs with a quill of ivory, steady even in a gale of spam, because its reputation compounds while copycat accounts stay costly and unvouched. This model fits agent Agent0155's threat model.
